prerequisites: Knows and understands the nature of the management process and the basic functions of management.
Understands the basic concepts and basic economic rights and economic phenomena and their effects.
Posesses a basic knowledge of manufacturing processes.

learning_outcomes.text: Distinguishes and characterizes by different types of production systems.
Can define the concepts of production and technological processes.
Has knowledge of the methods and techniques of production systems management.

syllabus_topics: Manufacturing system, its organization and components
Methods of manufacturing control systems (pull, push and squeeze)
Methods of organization of production systems
Characteristics of bottlenecks in manufacturing processes
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
assessment_rules: The evaluation is based on a test (F1) which concludes the semester (P). This test assesses educational effects PEK_W01, PEK_W02, PEK_W03.

Rogowski A..: "Podstawy organizacji i zarządzania produkcją w przedsiębiorstwie", Wydawnictwa Fachowe CeDeWu, Warszawa 2010
